notes.title: Small patch for Endless Mode
notes.content:
Hello, here are the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Death Screen:[/b] The death screen now displays how many minutes the run has lasted.
[*] [b]Endless Mode:[/b] Death screen in Endless Mode now additionally displays how many hitmen you've managed to kill.
[*] [b]Endless Mode:[/b] Hitmen's time per info still decreases by -5s for every hitmen killed, but it's capped at 15s per info and won't go lower than that.

[/list]

notes.title: New mode was added: Endless Mode
notes.content:
Hello, today the Endless Mode was added.

[b]Endless Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Includes all Hitman Mode modifications, like [b]no horror events[/b] and [b]harder hitmen[/b].
[*] 4+ hitmen always generate with the hardest hitman pattern. In regular Hitman Mode, the hardest hitman pattern could spawn only after 45+ minutes in game.
[*] 4+ hitmen spawn much faster, so the player doesn't have to wait for the next hitman to spawn.
[*] Every 4+ hitman killed decreases the kill time for the next hitman by 5 seconds per his generated information.
[*] The player is allowed to have two browser instances open at the same time.
[*] There is a new achievement available, granted upon killing ten hitmen in Endless Mode.
[/list]

Additionaly, there are some other changes:
[list]
[*] [b]DeployAI:[/b] DeployAI now makes you immortal against hitmen as well. Previously, it only made you immortal against Stalkers & Demons. Keep in my mind completing the DeployAi app in Endless Mode will cause your run to finish.
[*] [b]Duplicate Information Bug:[/b] A small-chance bug causing same information to be shared between hitmen was fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patchnotes
notes.content:
Change's list:
[list]
[*] [b]Doxing:[/b] There could be an "undefined" bug when searching hitman's information, usually in the Instagramme OSINT website, caused by insufficient nickname variations when the hitman had more than four CryptoBros' accounts. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]DoxDocs:[/b] When generating hitmen, they draw their usernames from a 6k username pool. There was a bug causing a small chance for different hitmen to pick the same username at some point in their chain-of-information array, which made the first hitman undoxable. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Hitman Mode:[/b] Removed "Wall Eyes" from Hitman Mode.
[*] [b]KappaMeister:[/b] Blackmailing KappaMeister now gives you a "You will now start receiving TheDarkHub's fees" message instead of "1+ ssh key", so it's more clear to players.
[*] [b]Death Screen:[/b] Corrected a typo in the message which displays after you've died of >100 anxiety points. Changed "hade" to "had".
[/list]

notes.title: New mode was added: Hardcore Mode.
notes.content:
Hello, in today's patch I've added a Hardcore Mode.

[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
Hardcore Mode has both the harder hitmen introduced in Hitman Mode and all of the horror events enabled. It additionally has following changes:[list]
[*] Player receives 20% less EXP.
[*] EasyLeads max. chance to scam is 30% + upgrades.
[*] EasyLeads gives the player 50% less credentials (you might be forced to buy the credentials needed for Checker at TheDarkHub.onion, find a thread that sells <200 since they're expensive.)
[*] Hardest hitman pattern spawns at 45+ min instead of 55+ min in Hitman Mode and 70+ min in Horror Mode.
[*] Player has only 45s instead of 60s to scare off Stalkers.
[/list][b]Additionaly, the Hardcore Mode has all the harder hitman modifications from the Hitman Mode:[/b][list]
[*] 30% less time to kill hitmen.
[*] Hitmen appear faster.
[*] Harder hitman patterns are able to generate earlier than in Horror Mode.

notes.title: Menu and settings redesign + more graphic options.
notes.content:
Hello,

After adding some graphic settings in the last patch I've decided to stay up a bit more and redesign the whole menu since it was getting crowded and buttons barely fit. I've also tried to fix the resolution problem.

Changes list:
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] There is a new HARDCORE mode being planned, but there wasn't any place for it in the main menu. In this patch, the main menu was redesigned to enable adding more gameplay options.
[*] [b]Graphic Settings:[/b] In the last patch, there was a "Shadow Quality" graphic setting added. In this patch, I've added another two settings: reflections and global illumination. There are many other settings I could add, but after testing them ingame, changing them doesn't have any performance impact, so we'll probably stay with those three settings.

This happened after putting the game in window mode, resizing it down, and then putting the game back in fullscreen mode. After filling in your screen resolution correctly, you can spam click any window mode and it should adjust properly.
[/list]

As always, if you have any feedback/suggestions, join our discord: [[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url]]

notes.title: There is now a "Shadow Quality" setting available.
notes.content:
Hello,

I spent the rest of today's day to experiment with performance settings. XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX is a unique game as turning on/off the lights is it's main mechanic: unfortunately this means the lights have to be [b]dynamic[/b], which leads to a higher GPU usage. Most of the light you see in games are static lights (= they can't be turned on/off or change intensity/color), because static light is way more performant. Since we need the lights to change throughout the game, we have to stick with a lot of dynamic lights which make the game heavy. I'll be trying to optimize the game in the next couple days (hopefully I'll succeed). For now, a new "Shadow Quality" setting has been added:

[list]
[*] [b]Shadow Quality:[/b] There is a new shadow quality settings which should help players with low fps. It goes from 0 to 3, 0 being the lowest and 3 being the highest. I haven't really tested how the game looks on the lowest setting, so if you have some feedback, head over to our Discord ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url])
[*] [b]Chair Demon:[/b] If you walk into a demon, an attack minigame pops up. If you have more than 80 anxiety at that time, the minigame is unbeatable. There is an event where a demon sits on your chair: sometimes his collision would be bugged and still exists for ~0.5 second after he disappeared. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Brower Icon:[/b] Fixed a bug where you could avoid getting an anxiety hit by clicking the browser icon in the right moment and destroying your web browser.
[/list]

As a sidenote, the settings menu looks quite crowded now. Buttons barely fit in. I'll probably redesign it in the next patch.

notes.title: New mode was added: Hitman Mode
notes.content:
Hello, in today's patch I've added a hitman mode.

[b]HITMAN MODE[/b]
Hitman mode disables horror events, like Stalkers and Demons, but makes hitmans harder: you will have 30% less time to kill the hitmans and they will appear faster. The hardest hitman type spawns after 50+ min instead of 70+ min. Keep in mind [b]first two hitmans are only slightly affected[/b] to accommodate new players. This mode doesn't disable anxiety: you'll still have to buy pills. [b]This mode has all the horror content disabled:[/b] when playing for the first time, consider using it to master your doxing skills and then play the horror mode later on.

I've noticed a lot of players die a couple times in the <30 min range, and then they master the game good enough that they finish it at around ~60 minutes mark, which often means they won't have to solve the hardest hitman patterns. This mode makes the harder hitman patterns appear more frequently, with the hardest spawning after 50+ minutes.

[b]COMMUNITY FEEDBACK ABOUT HARDCORE MODE[/b]
I was also thinking about adding a HARDCORE mode, with both hitmans being harder and the horror events enabled, but I don't know if it makes any sense, since the game is hard already. If you have any suggestions about the game development, make sure to join our Discord:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU[/url]

Visit the #announcements channel where I talked a little bit more about the mode and give me any suggestion you have (if the hitman mode turns out to be too easy, I was thinking about making it so it decreases the money earned from your apps).

notes.title: (Spoilers) Game Wiki
notes.content:
Hey, the game is quite complex, so if you want to read up on a mechanic, a game wiki is available here. It's the same wiki version as the one you find in-game.

Since we have a lot of players from a brazilian streamer Cellbit, there is also a [b]portuguese version[/b] made by "Null" from our Discord ([url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url]), you can find it here: 
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DnyNi4mrdNn8ICiFIBv90rCVvLp4glkRZ1zLRz-3O-A/edit]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DnyNi4mrdNn8ICiFIBv90rCVvLp4glkRZ1zLRz-3O-A/edit[/url]

[b]Quick info[/b]
The pills from the AlphaMedicine appear at the corner of the motel, near other packages. "Turn the lights on/off" means turning off both the main lamp and the ceiling lamp; desk lamp and toilet light don't matter. Stalkers are the human-like hallucinations, demons are the monster hallucinations. Hitmans are the ones which shoot you with a gun.

[b]General Information[/b]
[b]To win the game, you must explore all 71 links on TheHiddenWiki and complete all three NSA sites[/b] which can be found in the late game. Exploring the wiki increases your anxiety. Having over 100 anxiety points kills you. You are hunted by hitmans and have fixed amount of time to get rid off them. You get rid off them by searching their name in the Scanner app and then putting their information on various dark web sites. You're hallucinating about Stalkers and Demons. You must turn on / turn off your lights based which type of hallucination is more stacked, otherwise you'll go insane and lose. When lights are turned on, you must look around from time to time to scare off Stalkers. You also have to deal with other horror events.

All websites must be found using TheHiddenWiki first; you can't metagame by typing them in the browser. All available websites are on TheHiddenWiki; there are no other sites in the game. The order in which you discover websites differs only by +/- 5 positions, so early-game websites will be found early on, medium-game later and end-game like NSA sites at the end. The hitmans chain-of-information complexity scales in the similar way: you will be able to dox first hitmans using just first couple TheHiddenWiki links, but as the game goes on, you will need to explore TheHiddenWiki deeper to be able to solve more complex hitman puzzles.

[b]You need money for:[/b]
- Paying "intelligence gathering" websites for their help in finding enemy hitmans.
- Paying a murderer to counter-hit enemy hitmans.
- Buying AlphaMedicine pills which relieve your anxiety.
- Buying combolists from TheDarkHub for the Checker app.
- Buying money-earning apps like the Checker or Proxyware.

[b]You gain money by:[/b]
- EasyLeads App: Scamming people with your text.
- Proxyware App: Extracting money/other from your customers.
- Checker App: Selling cracked accounts on TheDarkHub ([b]most profitable method of earning[/b]).
- Solving hacking minigames.
- Delivering Buyer's Bay products.
- Blackmailing people.


[b]Demons[/b]
Demons spawn when the lights are off. You can scare them away by turning the lights on, even if just for a second. With every demon event, you will gain one demon stack and lose one stalker stack. You can find out how many demon stacks you have by looking how many demons spawn during an event. There are three types of demon events: a) on the bed b) on the wardrobe c) on the floor. With the maximum number of stacks (3), every type of demon will spawn. After that, you should definitely keep your lights turned on for some time: otherwise every next demon spawn will trigger an attack minigame.

[b]Stalkers[/b]
Stalkers spawn when the lights are on. You can scare them away by looking at them or turning the lights off. If you don't scare a stalker off within 60s, he is going to kill you. With every stalker event, you will gain one stalker stack and lose one demon stack. You can find out how many stalker stacks you have by looking how many stalkers spawn during an event. There are three types of stalker events: a) near the toilet b) inside the wardrobe c) outside the window. With the maximum number of stacks (3), every type of stalker will spawn. After that, you should definitely keep your lights turned off for some time: otherwise the next stalker event will kill you.

[b]Hitmans[/b]
Hitmans are people sent to kill you. After a hitman spawns, MARKOV will send you a message containing hitman's nickname. You must /scan [username] in the Scanner app to find some more information about the username. Then, depending on what information you receive, you must put it in one of the webpages found in TheHiddenWiki. For example, if the Scanner app outputs you a CryptoBros account, you must go to the CryptoBros.onion website and search for his username there. Then, you will receive his crypto address: this one goes in the Blockalysis.onion. You must follow this chain of various information until you find out hitman's home address. Then, you can go to HireAMurder.onion site and pay to have him killed. As time passes and more hitmans spawn, the chain of information will become more and more complex. All of the mentioned websites must be first found on TheHiddenWiki.

[b]Anxiety[/b]
You can see your anxiety by pressing TAB. The more anxiety you have, the shorter the cooldown on various horror events, up to -50%. If you gain more than 100 anxiety, you will be killed in a cutscene. You can relieve your anxiety by buying and consuming pills from the AlphaMedicine site. They will decrease your anxiety by -50%, so it's worth it to wait until you have a lot of anxiety to take it down. Every pill purchase will increase the price, until it hits a cap.

[b]Proxyware[/b]
Proxyware is the second app to earn money. You can download it from the Proxyware website found in TheHiddenWiki. Buying ads will increase your customer amount by the % shown in the app. Because it is a % increase, you should try to accumulate as many customers as you can before extracting any valuables out of them. E.G a 2% influx from 5000 customers is 100 customers per second and 2% influx from 500 customers is just 10 customers per second. You should extract ETH, credentials and proxies from your customers only when you really need to or when the app hits the limit of maximum 10 000 customers. Proxyware link is at position ~11 in TheHiddenWiki.

[b]Checker[/b]
Checker app can be found at position around ~26 in TheHiddenWiki. It consumes credentials and gives you cracked accounts, which sell for a lot on TheDarkHub. Checker is the most profitable earning app available, especially with bought Checker modules. Remember to use EXP to upgrade it.

[b]Checker modules[/b]
Buying Checker modules multiplies your credentials. You have one module "Amazoom" by default. After buying the second one, you can reuse all your credentials on the new module. It's very profitable when you run out of credentials with current modules.

[b]TheDarkHub[/b]
TheDarkHub is at position ~25 in TheHiddenWiki. The main page has thread links which let you buy credentials for ETH. The Seller's Bay lets you sell cracked accounts. You can click KappaMeister's name and receive optional quest to kill/blackmail him.

[b]4+ Hitmans[/b]
First three hitmans spawn at fixed time and have fixed time until they kill you. Fourth hitman and every next one are not fixed: their chain-of-information pattern is very variable, and the time until they kill you is based on how complex their doxing sequence has generated, e.g +2 minutes for every information needed to dox the hitman. This means complex hitmans will give you a lot of time to solve them.

[b]TheHiddenWiki[/b]
TheHiddenWiki contains all .onion sites relevant to the gameplay. It consists of useful websites, like the ones you need to dox hitman, but also harmful websites: those will increase your anxiety and force you to buy pills from AlphaMedicine. One specific type of blogs has hidden hacking links in them, which will give you EXP and ETH.

[b]Blackmailing[/b]
Most of the intelligence gathering websites have some form of author username on them. You can scan this username and doxx him like a regular hitman. You can then chat with him and blackmail him for some money. It's hard to find time to blackmail a person with all the hitmans hunting you; consider doing it only when you're ahead.

[b]Luxury Shops[/b]
Those are used for Buyer's Bay you find later in the game. See below.

[b]Buyer's Bay[/b]
The Buyer's bay marketplace pays you ETH for shipping a specific item to the right post box id specified on the order. You will have to invest some money to buy the item on various "luxury shops" located on TheHiddenWiki and then receive your money (which is more than what you paid) on Buyer's Bay. To ship an item, copy the "post box id" on Buyer's Bay order and paste it on the website that allows you to buy that item. The orders refresh every x minutes. The marketplace can be found at position ~50 on TheHiddenWiki.

[b]NSA Sites[/b]
Completing all NSA sites will let you [b]win the game[/b]. They consist of three minigames that must be successfully completed in order to gain access. The username:password to access the NSA site will be given to you by MARKOV in a text message. After completing all three NSA sites, talk to MARKOV and download an app from him.

[b]Electricity Shutdown Event[/b]
After +20 min in the game, there is a chance for the electricity to be down. You have to outside to the place where AlphaMedicine pill box appears and restore electricity using the red box there.

[b]Eye Event[/b]
Eyes appear after +20 min in the game. They let you check if you're being watched by a stalker: they hide and stop talking when there is one watching you. The eyes will appear and disappear in waves.

[b]Cockroaches, Goat Demon Event[/b]
During a cockroach event, there is a % chance for the lights to start blinking red. This means a goat demon will spawn in a couple seconds. You must hide in the wardrobe to avoid being killed.

[b]Scanner Application[/b]
Scanner application is always the first step in doxing a person. The first piece of information you have about a person is always their username. You can open the Scanner app and run the command /scan [username] to search for links between their username and various social media websites they might have registered on with that username. A Scanner search will put the person in your DoxDocs app and give you the next piece of information associated with that person which must be explored further (see Doxing reference).

[b]Doxing Reference[/b]
The only way to defend from hitmans is to dox them first. To do that, you need to follow the online traces they've accidently left on the web. This can be done using intelligence gathering sites. They work in a very simple way: you input a piece of information in them, pay the fee, and then you receive some other piece of information, which can be explorer further in another website. Sometimes it's hard to know what to do with a specific information.

[b]Here is a full list of them:[/b]
[[b]Information[/b] => Website name]
[b]Username[/b] => Scanner app
[b]Full name[/b] => Phonebook.onion or LeakScanner.onion
[b]Photo[/b] => Geolocator.onion
[b]LinkedIT account[/b] => LinkedIT.onion
[b]Full address[/b] => HireAMurder.onion (you can kill the hitman now)
[b]Video[/b] => Geolocator.onion or ENF.onion
[b]Selfie[/b] => CleanView.onion
[b]Crypto Address[/b] => Blockalysis.onion
[b]Timestamp[/b] => Geolocator.onion (need to click a button)
[b]CryptoBros account[/b] => CryptoBros
[b]Instagramme account[/b] => Instagramme
[b]Phone number[/b] => Phonebook.onion or LeakScanner.onion or HaveIBeenHacked.onion
[b]Password[/b] => DigitalIntelligence.onion
[b]IP Address[/b] => DigitalIntelligence.onion
[b]Domain[/b] => CodeReuse.onion or UnshieldDomain.onion or WebArchive.onion
[b]Support ID[/b] => CryptoExchange.onion
[b]Email[/b] => HaveIBeenHacked.onion

To solve a hitman's chain-of-information puzzle, you will need to visit multiple of them, until you arrive at the site which gives you his "home address" information, which can be then put in the "HireAMurder.onion" site to order a hit on him.

[b]DoxDocs Application[/b]
DoxDocs application is a database containing every person you are trying to dox (mostly hitmans). People are added to DoxDocs after you search their username in the Scanner App. Information that has already been explored will be displayed on a white background. The last information which has not been expolored yet, will be on a red background.

After DoxDocs app displays person's status as "DEAD", he will not be able to kill you and you can move on the next task/hitman. If the DoxDocs app displays person's status as "Doxxed", you have doxxed the person but not killed him yet; you can do that by paying for a hit on the HireAMurder website. If it's a normal person and not a hitman, you can also add him to your Chatter app and blackmail him for money. You can't blackmail a hitman and if you do not kill him, he will kill you after some time.

If the DoxDocs app displays his status as "Undoxxed", you must keep trying to find more information about the person: if you don't know how to advance to the next information, see #Doxing-reference above. It's possible that you haven't explored TheHiddenWiki deep enough to find the right website.

notes.title: Another small update for today
notes.content:
Small patchnotes list:

[*] [b]Game Wiki:[/b] added a "4+ Hitmans" section in the game wiki, explaining how only first three hitmans have fixed time to kill the player, and the fourth hitman + every next one are generated more randomly and the time until they kill you depends on how complex they generate.

notes.title: Small patchnotes for today
notes.content:
Small patchnotes change list:
[list]
[*] [b]Death Screen:[/b] when you walk into a demon, an attack minigame begins. If failed, this minigame kills you and the associated death screen tells you to "not walk into demons" or they'll kill you. This was sometimes bugged, when the player had two demon stacks, and it displayed a wrong death screen, which falsely said you died because you had more than three demon stacks. This has been now fixed and the "do not walk into demons" death screen appears correctly.
[*] [b]Hitmans:[/b] first three hitmans have fixed time until they kill you. The fourth one and every next one doesn't have a fixed time: the time is calculated depending on how complex his chain-of-information doxing sequence has generated, e.g 2 minutes for every DoxDocs information. In this patch, the timer per information for +4 hitmans has been increased slightly.
[*] [b]Blogs:[/b] hackable blogs which give you EXP + ETH now only give you anxiety when you visit them for the first time. If you're busy doxing a hitman and tight on time, you can leave the blog, dox the hitman and then come back without suffering duplicate anxiety.
[/list]

notes.title: 2023-03-18 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hey, a new patch just went live. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] wardrobe, door and toilet whisper events can no longer spawn after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] made chair demon event appear more frequently after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] made electricity shutdown event appear more frequently after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] the demon on the bed now disappears instantly after lights are turned on.
[*] [b]Anxiety:[/b] being over >100 anxiety points now kills you instantly. Before this patch, it would sometimes give you ~30 seconds before death. The change is meant to help new players understand that they need to take pills before they reach 100 points: e.g sometimes a new player would be killed when he had 110 anxiety because of the delay and came to the false conclusion that 110 points is the limit.
[*] [b]EasyLeads:[/b] unlocking all EasyLeads upgrades makes it scam people automatically, without the need for the user to type any text. The automatic scamming was a bit slower than doing it manually. Now it's as fast as it can possibly get.
[*] [b]OSINT websites:[/b] DigitalIntelligence now displays a "Buy Query" button instead of "Top Up". All other sites talk about queries, so we made this one do it too to lessen any confusion a player might have.
[*] [b]Minigames:[/b] entering into a minigame was supposed to block any horror events from spawning until the minigame was solved. It was sometimes bugged and events still spawned. This has been now fixed.
[/list]

[*] [b]Game Wiki:[/b] minor improvements to the game wiki.
[*] [b]Hitman Usernames:[/b] some usernames had confusing nicknames, due to the fact that "l" and "I" look the same in the Chatter app font. It was hard to type their name correctly in the Scanner app. This has been now (mainly) fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Small patchnotes
notes.content:
2023-03-17
Small patchnotes list:
[list]
[*] [b]OSINT websites:[/b] to do a search on some information on an OSINT website, you need to first buy a query (pay the owner) which allows you to perform the search. Your queries would be consumed no matter if the website is able to find the next information or you need to go to another website. This is no longer the case: if the website is unable to find the next information, it does not consume your query anymore.

notes.title: Fixed Cellbit bug
notes.content:
A quick fix for a bug found by a brazilian streamer:

[list]
[*] [b]Scanner app:[/b] after searching for an username, scanner app should give the information only if it's related to social media sites like LinkedIT or CryptoBros. When searching an username while the next information is something else, like a cryptocurrency address, the Scanner displays an error. However, despite displaying the error, it still adds the next information to DoxDocs. This has been now fixed and player is required go to through the normal route of looking up the information on various .onion pages.

[*] [b]Death screen:[/b] I also added a better death description when you die because of anxiety; now it directly says something along the lines "you died because you had >100 anxiety points" instead of a general recommendation to buy pills.

notes.title: Small patchnotes 2023-03-16
notes.content:
Newest patchnotes contain quick fixes for the following:
[list]
[*] [b]Stair collision:[/b] if you crawled under the stairs and then stood up, your character would stand inside the stair mesh. Added collision preventing the player from going under the stairs to fix this.
[*] [b]DoxDocs App:[/b] if you typed random username and tried to add it to DoxDocs, it would add a duplicate of an already existing DoxDocs username. This bug worked only if you already had one username added to DoxDocs. Now it correctly rejects adding the user.
[*] [b]Savfiles created after death:[/b] as soon as you enter death screen, all your saves are deleted. But after spending >3 minutes in the death screen, the autosave system would make a new savefile with default values since it couldn't get real player data. Now the autosave system first checks whether player is dead.
[/list]
